facts.fact: The Ministry of Health, with the National Bureau of Statistics, published the inaugural 2025 Health Statistics Abstract covering 2021 to 2024, drawing routine facility data from DHIS2 alongside surveys and modelled estimates; the document gives no release date beyond its 2025 publication year, so the published date is used.

systems.country_label: Republic of South Sudan 2025 Health Statistics Abstract
systems.owner: Ministry of Health; National Bureau of Statistics

note: No vital statistics report: the abstract says CRVS remains underdeveloped and most indicators are modelled estimates, so nothing is recorded for vital or series.
